title: Van Flandern's speed-of-gravity argument

tellings.quote: a physicist called van flandern um argues that the speed of gravity is at least two billion times the speed of light

plain: A physicist named Tom Van Flandern argued that gravity travels at least two billion times faster than light, according to the researcher Rupert Sheldrake. Sheldrake mentions the argument on the show without naming a paper or book. If true, gravity would act almost instantly across space, which would sit badly with Einstein's rule that nothing goes faster than light.
